notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.40 repairs subscriber-school logos on CBT pages and retains scoped branding for offline restarts. Adds an older-Chrome compatibility client while preserving password security, answer recovery and examination safeguards. Back up and update both servers between examinations. Load Online Settings once with internet access on each server to retrieve the school logo, then reopen the student page at the same address. No new tablet APK is required. Chrome 70 syntax is the build target, not a guarantee for every old browser or device. Keep available Chrome/WebView security updates installed. Existing tests, answers and scores are preserved.
